tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Lists every Asia Pulse data product with its price in USD, its HTTPS endpoint and MCP tool name, and the x402 payment networks (Base USDC, X Layer USD₮0). Free, no arguments. Call this first to choose a product.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Returns the SHA-256 hashes of our daily sealed product snapshots and the X Layer transactions that anchor them, for the last N days (days: 1 to 30, default 30), so you can check that a past response was not changed later. Free.
